sophie_support: FYI -- ACME reported a sudden p95 jump and intermittent 504s on /v1/rerank around 2026-02-22T14:03Z. They sent a repro and request ids. Attaching short log excerpt and the gist of the payload.

sophie_support: log snippet:
```
2026-02-22T14:03:12Z  gateway -> rerank  504  req_id=cust-req-8f1  route=/v1/rerank
2026-02-22T14:03:12Z  rerank-2  ERROR  json_unmarshal: candidate_count=17120 size=~23MB  req_id=cust-req-8f1
2026-02-22T14:03:12Z  upstream  ->  gateway  502  connection_reset  inst=rerank-2
```

liam_eng-runtime: Thanks @sophie_support. Initial read: huge candidate arrays causing big single-shot JSON allocations and GC pressure in the rerank service (Go). That explains tail latencies and 502/504 cascade. Do we have sanitized full payload? Need to repro locally with same candidate_count distribution.

sophie_support: Customer provided sanitized payload (trimmed):
```
{ "query": "...", "candidates": [ {"id":"c1", "features":{...} }, {"id":"c2",...}, /* ~17k entries */ ] }
```
They said they routinely send 10k-20k candidates and their client retries are aggressive (3x immediate).

anjali_eng-platform: Observed a coincident spike in requests from that API key at 14:02Z. Likely retry amplification. Propose: short-term gateway rejects for requests with candidate_count > 3000 or content-length > 6MB (413). Also disable automatic gateway retries on this route to avoid thundering herd. Thoughts?

liam_eng-runtime: I'm on board with a 413 guard. Typical production pattern is to cap at 1k-2k, but 3k is reasonable as temporary. I'll also add a local payload generator to repro CPU/heap behavior. Longer term: implement streaming JSON decode (json.Decoder.Token/streaming) or NDJSON input so we never allocate the full candidate slice at once.

marisol_sre: I'll add a canary gateway rule: route /v1/rerank -> header check for X-Candidate-Count or content-length threshold and set 413. I'll also disable envoy retry_policy on this route and temporarily increase rerank ASG by +2 nodes. Deploying canary in 2m.

customer_jordan: We can try sending 2k candidates for the next hour and turn off client-side retries. We'll report back. Concerned about quality degradation but can test.

liam_eng-runtime: Repro steps for eng: 
1) generate payload: `python tools/make_rerank_payload.py --candidates 17000 --features 64 > big.json`
2) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d @big.json -H "Content-Type: application/json" -v -w '\\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code}\\n'`
3) capture pprof during request: `go tool pprof -http=:6060 http://rerank:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30` and heap: `/debug/pprof/heap`. Expect: large heap allocation spike, frequent GC, CPU hot on encoding/json.

liam_eng-runtime: Local run results: single request with 17k candidates -> ~800ms spent in json.Unmarshal, heap grew ~200MB, GC cycles increased, p95 spike ~2s. Filing GH issue: rerank#642 (streaming-unmarshal + candidate_count_guard). Assigning to eng-runtime.

anjali_eng-platform: Can confirm: gateway logs show retries from client -> gateway -> backend repeated. I'll push `retry_policy: none` for route /v1/rerank to canary config. That should remove retry amplification.

marisol_sre: Canary deployed: content-length rule (6MB), candidate_count header validation, and disabled retries on rerank. Monitoring: upstream_5xx_rate fell from 4.1% -> 0.9% in the canary pool after 5min. Rolling to 100% now. Also bumped ASG +2 until code fix. Added alert: rerank.upstream_5xx_rate > 2% -> pager.

liam_eng-runtime: Short-term plan: implement server-side guard (return 413 with structured error and guidance) + add telemetry for candidate_count. Medium-term: streaming decode and NDJSON ingestion with backpressure, or internal chunked scoring where we keep candidate metadata in lightweight index and fetch features as needed.

sophie_support: Customer update: asked them to try 2k candidates and remove retries. Will follow up in 30m.

customer_jordan: Reduced payload to 1500 candidates and disabled retries. No 504s in 15 minutes. Thank you, team. :pray:

liam_eng-runtime: Great repro confirmation. I'll open a PR for the 413 guard and add unit tests. PR will include: 1) read X-Candidate-Count header or count array up to threshold w/o allocating features fully, 2) return 413 JSON: `{"error":"candidate_count_exceeded", "max":3000, "hint":"use paging or incremental rerank"}`. Will canary the change.

marisol_sre: Deploybot: user-triggered deploy started: canary-gateway-rerank-guard by marisol_sre -- sha=9b7d21

deploybot: Canary passed health checks. Rolling out to 100%.

liam_eng-runtime: Leaving notes in internal triage: /internal/triage/2198765432 (pprof traces, heap graphs). Will link GH PR when ready and schedule follow-up to design NDJSON API.

sophie_support: Summary & next steps:
- Customer to test reduced candidate_count -> verified success (customer_jordan) 
- SRE applied gateway content-length and disabled retries -> reduced 5xx amplification (marisol_sre)
- Eng-runtime to deliver short-term 413 guard + telemetry + unit tests, medium-term streaming decode (liam_eng-runtime)
- Support to confirm with customer and close ticket after PR & metrics stable (sophie_support)

sophie_support: Closing loop with customer now. Will reopen if any regressions. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
